info.title: Amicu Management API
info.description: First-party auth plus the stateless validate/plan engine endpoints.

200.description: JSON Web Key Set: the issuer's public verification keys.
OpenID Connect discovery document.

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout Session for the logged-in user and return its URL.
post.description:
Ensures the user has a Stripe customer (creating and persisting one on first
use so later webhooks map back), then opens a subscription checkout for the
requested plan's price. Returns `503` when billing is unconfigured.

200.description: A Stripe Checkout Session URL to redirect the browser to.

502.description: The billing provider could not be reached.

503.description: Billing is not configured on this server.

post.summary:
Create a Stripe Billing Portal session so the user can manage their
subscription, and return its URL. `409` if the user has no customer yet.

200.description: A Stripe Billing Portal URL to redirect the browser to.

409.description: The user has no billing account yet.

502.description: The billing provider could not be reached.

503.description: Billing is not configured on this server.

get.summary:
Report the user's billing status: whether Stripe is configured, their
authoritative current plan, and whether they hold a subscription.

200.description: The user's billing status and current plan.

post.description:
Authenticated by the `Stripe-Signature` HMAC over the raw body (no bearer
token). On `customer.subscription.created|updated` the subscription's price
is mapped to a tier and persisted; on `customer.subscription.deleted` the
user is dropped back to Community. Unknown event types are acknowledged with
`200` and ignored. The new tier applies on the user's next token issuance.

200.description: Event received (and applied, if relevant).

503.description: Billing is not configured on this server.

get.summary: List every config in the workspace.

200.description: Every config in the workspace, by name.

post.summary: Create a config from submitted HCL, canonicalizing it first.

201.description: The created config's first version, content included.

400.description: The submitted HCL failed to parse.

409.description: A config with this name already exists.

get.summary: Fetch a config's current version, content included.

200.description: The current version, content included.

404.description: No config exists with this id.

get.summary: Compute a unified diff between two versions' canonical HCL content.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The version number to diff from.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The version number to diff to.

200.description: A unified diff from `from`'s content to `to`'s.

404.description: No config, or no such version (from or to), exists.

post.summary: Roll back a config to an earlier version's content.
post.description:
History is append-only: this mints a brand-new version whose content
copies version `{no}`; it never rewrites or removes any prior version.

parameters.name: no
parameters.description: The version number to roll back to.

404.description: No config, or no such version, exists.

get.summary: List every version of a config, oldest first (metadata only, no content).

200.description: Every version, oldest first. Empty (not 404) for an unknown config id.

post.summary: Append a new version onto a config, canonicalizing its content first.

400.description: The submitted HCL failed to parse.

404.description: No config exists with this id.

get.summary: Fetch one specific version's content and metadata.

200.description: That version's full content and metadata.

404.description: No config, or no such version, exists.

post.summary: Return the monitoring view for a measured metrics + estimate snapshot.
post.description:
Validates and normalizes the submitted surface, runs the advisory
[`diagnose`] rule engine, and returns the metric surface, the estimate, and
the tier-appropriate advisory suggestions. Stateless and side-effect-free:
nothing is collected, stored, or applied.

200.description: The normalized metric surface, estimate, and tier-appropriate advisory suggestions.

403.description: Access tier insufficient to reach the endpoint.

422.description: The JSON body is well-formed but a field has the wrong type or is missing; body is a plain-text decode error.

get.summary:
The audit log, most-recent first. Requires the `view_audit` permission
(Owner/Admin).

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

200.description: The audit log, most-recent first.

403.description: Below Enterprise, not a member, or your role may not view the audit log.

get.summary: List the organization's members and their roles.

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

200.description: The members and the caller's own role.

403.description: Below the Enterprise tier, or not a member of the organization.

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

400.description: Empty user id, unknown role, or malformed organization header.

403.description: Below Enterprise, not a member, or your role may not add this member.

409.description: That user is already a member.

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

200.description: The removed member.

403.description: Below Enterprise, not a member, or your role may not remove this member.

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

200.description: The member's new role.

400.description: Unknown role, or malformed organization header.

403.description: Below Enterprise, not a member, or your role may not make this change.

409.description: The change would demote the last remaining Owner.

get.summary: The RBAC catalog: every role and the permissions it grants.

parameters.name: x-amicu-workspace-id
parameters.description: The caller's organization id (a UUID). Defaults to the single-tenant workspace when absent.

200.description: The role → permission catalog.

403.description: Below the Enterprise tier, or not a member of the organization.

post.description:
Parses the HCL (and optional prior-state HCL), surfaces structural errors
through the same diagnostic path as `/validate`, then diffs into the [`Plan`]
contract. When the config cannot be planned (structural errors, or
adapter-level validation errors) the response is `422` carrying the blocking
[`DiagnosticReport`]. Stateless and side-effect-free: no plan is applied.

200.description: The computed plan.

400.description: The config (or prior) text is not valid Amicu HCL.

422.description: The config is invalid and cannot be planned; body is a DiagnosticReport.

get.summary: List the guided-wizard presets for the gallery.
get.description:
Returns every catalog entry as a gallery-card summary. Stateless: the
catalog is a fixed, in-code list.

200.description: The preset gallery.

get.summary: Fetch one preset's detail to seed the wizard form.
get.description:
Returns the gallery summary plus the requirement defaults and the estimate
shown before any answers are collected. A `404` if the id is unknown.

200.description: The preset detail.

404.description: No preset exists with this id.

post.summary: Emit HCL for a preset from the wizard's answers.
post.description:
Deterministic: builds the preset's candidate [`Graph`](amicu_core::graph::Graph)
from the answers and renders it to HCL. No diagnosis is run and no metrics
are synthesized; the returned `estimate` is the preset's own
`default_estimate`, for display. A `404` if the id is unknown, a `400` if a
wizard answer is out of range.

200.description: The generated HCL plus the preset's estimate.

400.description: A wizard answer is out of range.

404.description: No preset exists with this id.

422.description: The JSON body is well-formed but a field has the wrong type or is missing.

post.summary: Diagnose a stack and return advisory recommendations.
post.description:
Runs the advisory rule engine over the submitted measured metrics and the
workload estimate, then returns the [`TuningReport`] *for the caller's tier*:
recommendations the caller has not unlocked are withheld (a Community token
gets `200` with an empty list, Pro+ gets the full depth). Stateless and
side-effect-free: nothing is applied - recommendations are advisory data.

200.description: The tier-appropriate advisory tuning report.

403.description: Access tier insufficient to reach the endpoint.

422.description: The JSON body is well-formed but a field has the wrong type or is missing; body is a plain-text decode error.

post.description:
Anti-enumeration: this ALWAYS returns the same generic `202 Accepted`,
whether or not the email is registered, with no account-existence signal in
the body or (Argon2 runs on neither path) the timing. A reset token is minted
and delivered out-of-band via the notification seam only when the account
exists. Mirrors the identical-response defense on `/signup`.

202.description: Accepted. If the email is registered, a reset link is sent out-of-band. Response is identical whether or not the account exists (anti-enumeration).

post.summary:
Complete a password reset: consume a valid reset token and install a new
password.
post.description:
On success the password hash is replaced and every refresh-token family the
user holds is revoked, forcing a fresh sign-in on all devices.

Both failure modes return `400`, but they are deliberately *not* the same
message: a weak new password gets a distinct, helpful policy message, while
an unknown/expired/already-used token gets a generic one. This leaks nothing,
because the password policy is checked *before* the token is looked up - so
the weak-password message can never depend on (and never signals) whether the
token is valid or which account it belongs to.

200.description: Password reset: the new password is installed and all prior sessions (refresh families) are revoked.

400.description: Either the new password fails policy (distinct, helpful message) or the reset token is unknown, expired, or already used (generic message). Policy is checked before token lookup, so neither message reveals token validity or account existence.

post.summary:
Anti-enumeration: both a brand-new registration and a hit on an existing
account return the *same* generic `202 Accepted` body, with the same Argon2
timing (the service hashes on both paths). Only request-level validation
(empty email / weak password) yields a distinguishable error, and that
reveals nothing about which accounts exist. Mirrors the identical-response
defense on `/signin`.

202.description: Accepted. If the email can be registered, a follow-up is sent out-of-band. Response is identical whether or not the account already exists (anti-enumeration).

400.description: Request-level validation failed (empty email or weak password).

200.description: Authenticated: an access + refresh token pair.
Rotated: a fresh access + refresh token pair.

401.description: Refresh token unknown, expired, or revoked.

post.description:
Parses the HCL and runs structural + per-deployment validation, returning the
[`DiagnosticReport`] contract. A config that parses but fails validation
still returns `200` with `valid: false`; only a parse error is a `400`.

200.description: Diagnostic report for the submitted config (may contain errors).

400.description: The config text is not valid Amicu HCL.

post.summary: Confirm an email address by consuming a verification token.
post.description:
The token is consumed atomically and single-use. Every rejected token
(unknown, expired, or already used) returns the same generic `400`, never a
`401`/`404`, so a rejection cannot be used to probe which tokens or accounts
exist. On success the account's email is marked verified.

200.description: Email verified: the account's email is now confirmed.

400.description: The verification token is unknown, expired, or already used (generic message, no enumeration).

post.description:
Anti-enumeration: this ALWAYS returns the same generic `202 Accepted`,
whether or not the email is registered and whether or not it is already
verified, with no account signal in the body or (all account-dependent work
is detached) the timing. A fresh verification token is minted and delivered
out-of-band via the notification seam only when the account exists AND is not
yet verified. Mirrors the identical-response defense on `/recover`.

202.description: Accepted. If an unverified account exists for that email, a fresh verification link is sent out-of-band. Response is identical whether or not the account exists or is already verified (anti-enumeration).

ActionKind.description: The kind of change a [`PlannedAction`] represents.

user_id.description: The user id to add as a member.

content.description: The HCL configuration text. Canonicalized before it is stored.

message.description: An optional human note describing this version.

Artifact.description: A selected model artifact and its download characteristics.

AssumptionDto.description: A single stated assumption an estimate or diagnosis depends on.

AuditEntryView.description: One audit record as returned on the wire.

actor_id.description: The user id that performed the action.

target_id.description: The member the action targeted, if any.

timestamp.description: When the action was recorded (Unix seconds).

BillingStatusResponse.description:
The user's billing status: whether billing is live server-side, the
authoritative current plan, and whether an active subscription exists.

configured.description:
Whether Stripe is configured on the server. When `false` the UI must not
present checkout/manage actions (they would `503`).

has_subscription.description: Whether the user has an active Stripe subscription (drives manage-vs-buy).

plan.description:
The user's current plan, read from the durable user record (not just the
possibly-stale token). Lowercase tier name, e.g. `"community"`.

BottleneckClassDto.description:
The class of bottleneck a diagnosis assigns. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::BottleneckClass`].

ChangeDirectionDto.description:
Direction of a suggested change. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::ChangeDirection`].

CheckoutRequest.description: Request body for `POST /billing/checkout`: the plan the user wants to buy.

ComparisonDto.description:
Whether a measured metric sits above or below its threshold. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::Comparison`].

Confidence.description: Confidence level attached to an estimate.

ConfidenceDto.description:
How much an estimate or diagnosis can be relied on. Mirrors
[`amicu_core::estimate::Confidence`].

ConfigDetailDto.description:
A config's current version, content included. Returned by `POST /configs`
and `GET /configs/{id}`. Mirrors [`ConfigWithContent`].

content.description: The current version's canonical HCL content.

updated_at.description: When the current version was last touched, Unix seconds.

ConfigDiffDto.description:
Response for `GET /configs/{id}/diff`: a unified diff between two
versions' canonical HCL content.

diff.description:
A standard unified diff (`---`/`+++` headers, `@@` hunks) from
`from`'s content to `to`'s.

ConfigSummaryDto.description:
A config's identity and pointer metadata, without content. Returned by
`GET /configs`. Mirrors [`ConfigSummary`].

updated_at.description: When the current version was last touched, Unix seconds.

CostMetricsDto.description: Cost surface, including utilization-adjusted idle burn.

CostPerformance.description: Estimated cost and performance, with the basis for the estimate.

content.description:
The HCL configuration text. Canonicalized (parsed and reformatted)
before it is stored.

message.description: An optional human note describing this version.

Credentials.description: Email + password credentials for sign-up and sign-in.

code.description:
The standardized diagnostic code.

Serialized as the `AMICU-<CATEGORY>-<NNN>` string form.

path.description: The attribute path within the resource, if any.

resource.description: The resource address this diagnostic applies to, if any.

oneOf.description: Source location, if the diagnostic maps to a specific location.

suggested_fixes.description: Suggested fixes; omitted from output when empty.

DiagnosticReport.description: The top-level diagnostic report emitted by `--output json`.

valid.description: Whether the analyzed input is valid (no error-severity diagnostics).

EmitResponseDto.description:
Response for `POST /presets/{id}/emit`: the generated HCL text plus the
preset's estimate for display. The estimate is the preset's own
`default_estimate`, carried through unchanged; the emit path synthesizes no
metrics.

estimate.description: The preset's estimate, shown alongside the generated config.

hcl.description: The Amicu HCL configuration text produced from the preset and answers.

EstimateRangeDto.description:
An estimate range with the provenance and confidence behind it. On the
request side `assumptions` may be omitted; on the response side it carries
the range's stated attribution.

EvidenceDto.description: A measured metric that triggered a recommendation, with its threshold.

GpuMetricsDto.description: GPU surface. `vram_used` is a byte-size string, e.g. `"40GiB"` or `"0B"`.

LatencyMetricsDto.description: Latency surface: TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end (ms), each a percentile distribution.

MemberView.description: One member as returned on the wire.

caller_role.description:
The calling user's own role - so a client can render exactly the controls
their role allows (the API still enforces every action).

members.description: All members, in a stable order.

ModalityDto.description:
An input or output modality a use case requires. Mirrors
[`amicu_core::resource::Modality`].

MoneyDto.description: A monetary amount in a given ISO currency.

MonitorRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /monitor`: the measured metrics snapshot and the
workload estimate it is displayed against. Shares the metric + estimate DTOs
with `/recommend` (see [`crate::dto`]).

estimate.description: The workload estimate the measured surface is displayed alongside.

metrics.description:
The measured serving-metric surface for one stack (the same shape as
`GET /stacks/:id/metrics`).

MonitorViewDto.description:
What the monitoring dashboard renders: the server-normalized metric surface,
the normalized estimate (with its stated assumptions and confidence), and the
engine's advisory - never automatic - suggested changes.

The measured-vs-estimated comparison is *presentation*: the frontend places
the measured distributions next to the estimate's ranges and stated
assumptions. This DTO computes no verdict.

estimate.description:
The workload estimate, normalized and carrying its stated assumptions and
per-range confidence for honest side-by-side display.

metrics.description:
The measured metric surface, normalized server-side and echoed back so
the client renders validated values (e.g. a canonical `vram_used`).

suggestions.description:
The engine's advisory tuning report for the caller's tier: suggested (not
applied) changes with their evidence, rationale, confidence, and rejected
alternatives. Empty for a caller whose tier unlocks none of them.

Patch.description: A single JSON-patch-like edit that would resolve a diagnostic.

path.description: A JSON Pointer to the target location.

Plan.description:
A full plan: the set of actions Amicu would take, with the context needed
to review them.

actions.description: The planned actions, in application order.

oneOf.description: Aggregate policy outcome across all actions, if evaluated.

config.description: The Amicu HCL configuration text to plan.

prior.description:
Optional prior-state config, as HCL, to diff against. When omitted the
plan is computed against an empty prior (everything is a create).

PlannedAction.description: A single planned change to one resource.

oneOf.description: The selected artifact and its download characteristics.
Estimated cost and performance ranges with provenance.

required_action.description: Manual action the user must take before this can be applied.

required_secrets.description:
Names of secrets this action requires.

These are secret NAMES only. Secret values never appear in a plan.

runtime.description: Runtime and material launch settings, as opaque key/value pairs.

PolicyOutcome.description: Governance / policy outcome for a plan.

allowed.description: Whether the plan is permitted under evaluated policy.

denials.description: Reasons the plan was denied, if `allowed` is false.

PresetConstraintDto.description:
A hard constraint a preset commits to, shown on its gallery card. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::PresetConstraint`].

PresetDetailDto.description:
The full detail for one preset, used to seed the wizard form: the gallery
summary plus the requirement defaults and the estimate shown before any
answers are collected. Returned by `GET /presets/{id}`.

default_estimate.description: The estimate shown before any answers are collected.

requirement_defaults.description: Requirement defaults pre-filled into the wizard.

PresetSummaryDto.description:
A gallery card: the identity, marketing copy, hard constraints, and minimum
tier a preset commits to. Returned by `GET /presets`.

constraints.description: The hard constraints this preset commits to.

fit.description: Who and what this preset fits.

min_tier.description: Minimum product tier required to use this preset.

tagline.description: One-line summary shown under the name.

PriorityDto.description:
Relative importance of a use case. Mirrors
[`amicu_core::resource::Priority`].

ProvenanceDto.description:
Where the evidence behind an estimate comes from. Mirrors
[`amicu_core::estimate::Provenance`].

Range.description: An inclusive numeric range with an optional unit.

RecommendRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /recommend`: the measured metrics, the estimate they
are judged against, and (optionally) custom rule thresholds.

estimate.description: The workload estimate the metrics are compared against.

metrics.description:
The measured serving-metric surface for one stack (the same shape as
`GET /stacks/:id/metrics`).

oneOf.description:
Custom rule thresholds. Omit the whole object to use the conservative
engine defaults; provide any subset of fields to override just those,
with the omitted fields still falling back to the engine defaults.

RecommendationDto.description: An advisory, explainable tuning recommendation. `advisory` is always `true`.

email.description: The account email to send a reset link to.

message.description: A message that reveals nothing about whether the email is registered.

RedirectResponse.description: A hosted Stripe URL to redirect the browser to.

url.description: The Stripe-hosted URL (checkout or billing portal).

refresh_token.description: The opaque refresh token previously issued to this client.

RejectedAlternativeDto.description: A change the engine considered and ruled out, with why.

ReliabilityMetricsDto.description: Reliability surface. Rates are fractions in `[0, 1]`.

ResendVerificationRequest.description: A request to resend the email-verification link (`POST /verify/resend`).

email.description: The account email to send a fresh verification link to.

message.description: A message that reveals nothing about whether an unverified account exists.

ResetRequest.description:
A password-reset completion (`POST /reset`): the opaque reset token plus the
new password to install.

new_password.description: The new account password (must satisfy the password policy).

reset_token.description: The opaque reset token delivered out-of-band (e.g. via the reset link).

RoleView.description: One role and the permissions it grants (the RBAC catalog).

description.description: A short human description of the role.

permissions.description: The permission names this role holds.

RuntimeFamilyDto.description:
The serving runtime family a preset commits to. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::RuntimeFamily`].

Setting.description: An opaque runtime or launch setting.

value.description: Setting value, rendered as a string.

message.description: A message that reveals nothing about whether the email already exists.

SourceLocation.description: The location in a source file a diagnostic refers to.

StackMetricsDto.description: The full measured metric surface for one stack over an observation window.

SuggestedFix.description: A suggested fix attached to a diagnostic.

ThresholdsDto.description:
Rule trigger points. Every field is optional and independent: provide any
subset and the omitted fields fall back to the engine's conservative
defaults. Sending `{ "gpu_util_high": 0.9 }` overrides only that one trigger
point and leaves the rest at their defaults.

TierDto.description:
Product tier that unlocks a recommendation. Mirrors
[`amicu_recommend::Tier`].

TokenResponse.description: An issued access + refresh token pair.

access_token.description: Short-lived access JWT (verify offline via JWKS).

TuningReportDto.description: A diagnosis for one stack: its advisory recommendations, tier-appropriate.

recommendations.description:
Recommendations in severity order; the first is the primary diagnosis.
Empty for a caller whose tier unlocks none of them.

UseCaseDto.description:
A preset's requirement defaults, pre-filled into the wizard form. Mirrors
[`amicu_core::resource::UseCase`].

config.description: The Amicu HCL configuration text to validate.

VerifyRequest.description:
An email-verification completion (`POST /verify`): the opaque verification
token delivered out-of-band at sign-up.

token.description:
The opaque verification token delivered out-of-band (e.g. via the
"confirm your email" link).

VersionContentDto.description:
One version's full content plus its metadata. Returned by
`GET /configs/{id}/versions/{no}`. Mirrors [`VersionContent`].

created_at.description: When this version was created, Unix seconds.

created_by.description: The account id (UUID text) that created this version, if any.

message.description: An optional human note describing this version.

version_no.description: The version number (1-based, monotonic per config).

VersionMetaDto.description:
One version's metadata, without its content. Returned by
`GET /configs/{id}/versions` and as the result of an append or rollback.
Mirrors [`VersionMeta`].

content_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of this version's content.

created_at.description: When this version was created, Unix seconds.

created_by.description:
The account id (UUID text) that created this version, if any. See
[`created_by_for`] for how this is derived from the caller's token.

message.description: An optional human note describing this version.

version_no.description: The version number (1-based, monotonic per config).

WizardAnswersDto.description:
Request body for `POST /presets/{id}/emit`: the requirements the wizard
collected. Mirrors [`amicu_recommend::WizardAnswers`].

oneOf.description: Optional monthly spend ceiling; when set, becomes a budget.

concurrency.description: Expected concurrent requests. Drives GPU count. Must be > 0.

context_length.description: Context length (tokens) the runtime is configured for. Must be > 0.

eu_residency_required.description: Whether the workload must stay within EU jurisdictions.

max_latency_ms.description: Optional latency ceiling (ms) carried into the graph's use case.

WorkloadEstimateDto.description:
Expected serving behavior and the assumptions behind it. On the response side
`assumptions` carries the estimate's stated attribution (prompt/generation
length, concurrency) so a measured-vs-estimated divergence is attributable.

assumptions.description: Engine-derived attribution strings; ignored on input, populated on echo.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Sign-up, token issuance/rotation, logout, and JWKS discovery.

tags.name: engine
tags.description: Stateless, side-effect-free validate and plan endpoints (auth-gated).

tags.name: recommend
tags.description: Stateless advisory tuning recommendations from a metrics + estimate snapshot (auth-gated, tier-appropriate).

tags.name: monitor
tags.description: Stateless monitoring view (measured-vs-estimated): a normalized metric surface, estimate, and tier-appropriate advisory suggestions (auth-gated).

tags.name: preset
tags.description: Stateless guided-wizard presets: gallery listing, per-preset detail, and deterministic HCL emit from wizard answers (auth-gated, Community-usable).

tags.name: billing
tags.description: Stripe-backed subscription billing: checkout, customer portal, status, and the signature-authenticated webhook.

tags.name: org
tags.description: Enterprise-gated organization console: membership, role-based access control, and an append-only audit log.

tags.name: config
tags.description: HCL config storage and version history: create/list/get, append-only version history, rollback (mints a new version, never rewrites), and a server-computed unified diff. Content is canonicalized before it is stored (auth-gated, Community-usable).
